knowledge:
- key_parameters: k=The number of initial clusters in ICP (default 15; increasing k increases resolution) ;; d=A real number between 0 and 1 determining how many cells are down- or oversampled from each cluster into the training data (default 0.3; decreasing below 0.2 is not recommended, increasing above 0.3 decreases resolution) ;; C=A positive real number ruling the trade-off between correct classification and regularization in L1-regularized logistic regression (default 0.3; decreasing C increases stringency of feature selection) ;; r=The maximum number of reiterations performed until the ICP algorithm stops (default 500) ;; L=The number of ICP runs (default 200; 30 used for toy dataset) ;; reg.type=Regularization type, "L1" (default) or "L2" ;; threads=The number of threads to use in parallel computing (default 0, which uses all available threads but one; 1 disables parallelization) ;; icp.batch.size=The batch size of cells to use in ICP (default Inf; smaller decreases run time but is experimental) ;; p=The number of principal components to retain during PCA transformation of the joint probability matrix (default 50) ;; K=The number of consensus clusters to extract from the hierarchical clustering tree dendrogram
- alternatives: Typical pipelines that apply feature selection prior to dimensionality reduction by PCA (e.g., Seurat-like workflows). ILoReg is preferred when looking for rare cell populations or subtle transcriptomic differences without prior feature selection.
- when_to_use: When analyzing single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) data to identify cell populations, especially rare populations or those with subtle transcriptomic differences.
- pitfalls: Standardized features (non-sparse data) will likely cause much higher run time and memory usage because the method is designed for sparse data (dgCMatrix) ;; Decreasing d below 0.2 is not recommended due to the increased risk of ICP becoming unstable (where k starts to decrease during iteration) ;; SelectKClusters overwrites the manual clustering slot every time it is called ;; icp.batch.size is an experimental feature and has not been validated properly.

workflows.name: scrna_seq_cell_population_identification
workflows.intent: Identify high-resolution cell populations and marker genes from normalized scRNA-seq data using iterative clustering projection (ICP).
input: normalized_counts.rds (log-transformed, normalized gene expression matrix of class matrix, data.frame, or dgCMatrix)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare the SingleCellExperiment object for ILoReg analysis ;; 2. Run the ICP clustering algorithm L times in parallel ;; 3. Perform PCA transformation on the joint probability matrix and optionally plot elbow ;; 4. Perform nonlinear dimensionality reduction (UMAP and t-SNE) ;; 5. Visualize gene expression on dimensionality reduction plots ;; 6. Perform hierarchical clustering using Ward's method ;; 7. Extract consensus clustering with K clusters and plot ;; 8. Identify gene markers for all clusters ;; 9. Select top gene markers ;; 10. Visualize markers via heatmap or violin plots ;; 11. Optionally rename clusters, merge clusters, or estimate optimal K.
workflows.code:
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(logcounts = pbmc3k_500))
sce <- PrepareILoReg(sce)
set.seed(1)
sce <- RunParallelICP(object = sce, k = 15,
                      d = 0.3, L = 30, 
                      r = 5, C = 0.3, 
                      reg.type = "L1", threads = 0)
sce <- RunPCA(sce,p=50,scale = FALSE)
PCAElbowPlot(sce)
sce <- RunUMAP(sce)
sce <- RunTSNE(sce,perplexity=30)
GeneScatterPlot(sce,c("CD3D","CD79A","CST3","FCER1A"),
                dim.reduction.type = "umap",
                point.size = 0.3)
GeneScatterPlot(sce,c("CD3D","CD79A","CST3","FCER1A"),
                dim.reduction.type = "tsne",
                point.size = 0.3)
sce <- HierarchicalClustering(sce)
sce <- SelectKClusters(sce,K=13)
plot_grid(ClusteringScatterPlot(sce,
                                dim.reduction.type = "umap",
                                return.plot = TRUE,
                                title = "UMAP",
                                show.legend=FALSE),
          ClusteringScatterPlot(sce,
                                dim.reduction.type = "tsne",
                                return.plot = TRUE
                                ,title="t-SNE",
                                show.legend=FALSE),
          ncol = 1
)
gene_markers <- FindAllGeneMarkers(sce,
                                   clustering.type = "manual",
                                   test = "wilcox",
                                   log2fc.threshold = 0.25,
                                   min.pct = 0.25,
                                   min.diff.pct = NULL,
                                   min.cells.group = 3,
                                   return.thresh = 0.01,
                                   only.pos = TRUE,
                                   max.cells.per.cluster = NULL)
top10_log2FC <- SelectTopGenes(gene_markers,
                               top.N = 10,
                               criterion.type = "log2FC",
                               inverse = FALSE)
top1_log2FC <- SelectTopGenes(gene_markers,
                              top.N = 1,
                              criterion.type = "log2FC",
                              inverse = FALSE)
top10_adj.p.value <- SelectTopGenes(gene_markers,
                                    top.N = 10,
                                    criterion.type = "adj.p.value",
                                    inverse = TRUE)
top1_adj.p.value <- SelectTopGenes(gene_markers,
                                   top.N = 1,
                                   criterion.type = "adj.p.value",
                                   inverse = TRUE)
GeneScatterPlot(sce,
                genes = unique(top1_log2FC$gene),
                dim.reduction.type = "tsne",
                point.size = 0.5,ncol=2)
sce <- RenameAllClusters(sce,
                         new.cluster.names = c("GZMK+/CD8+ T cells",
                                               "IGKC+ B cells",
                                               "Naive CD4+ T cells",
                                               "NK cells",
                                               "CD16+ monocytes",
                                               "CD8+ T cells",
                                               "CD14+ monocytes",
                                               "IGLC+ B cells",
                                               "Intermediate monocytes",
                                               "IGKC+/IGLC+ B cells",
                                               "Memory CD4+ T cells",
                                               "Naive CD8+ T cells",
                                               "Dendritic cells"))
GeneHeatmap(sce,gene.markers = top10_log2FC)
VlnPlot(sce,genes = c("CD3D"),return.plot = FALSE,rotate.x.axis.labels = TRUE)
sce <- CalcSilhInfo(sce,K.start = 2,K.end = 50)
SilhouetteCurve(sce,return.plot = FALSE)
sce <- SelectKClusters(sce,K=20)
sce <- RenameCluster(sce,old.cluster.name = 1,new.cluster.name = "A")
sce <- SelectKClusters(sce,K=5)
custom_annotation <- plyr::mapvalues(metadata(sce)$iloreg$clustering.manual,c(1,2,3,4,5),LETTERS[1:5])
AnnotationScatterPlot(sce,
                      annotation = custom_annotation,
                      return.plot = FALSE,
                      dim.reduction.type = "tsne",
                      show.legend = FALSE)
sce <- SelectKClusters(sce,K=20)
sce <- MergeClusters(sce,clusters.to.merge  = c(3,4))
sce <- SelectKClusters(sce,K=13)
sce <- RenameAllClusters(sce,
                         new.cluster.names = c("GZMK+/CD8+ T cells",
                                               "IGKC+ B cells",
                                               "Naive CD4+ T cells",
                                               "NK cells",
                                               "CD16+ monocytes",
                                               "CD8+ T cells",
                                               "CD14+ monocytes",
                                               "IGLC+ B cells",
                                               "Intermediate monocytes",
                                               "IGKC+/IGLC+ B cells",
                                               "Memory CD4+ T cells",
                                               "Naive CD8+ T cells",
                                               "Dendritic cells"))
GM_naive_memory_CD4 <- FindGeneMarkers(sce,
                                       clusters.1 = "Naive CD4+ T cells",
                                       clusters.2 = "Memory CD4+ T cells",
                                       logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                       min.pct = 0.25,
                                       return.thresh = 0.01,
                                       only.pos = TRUE)
GM_dendritic <- FindGeneMarkers(sce,
                                clusters.1 = "Dendritic cells",
                                logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                                min.pct = 0.25,
                                return.thresh = 0.01,
                                only.pos = TRUE)
